questions.q: Aqueous bromine is shaken with an alkene. What is the colour change?
questions.why: Bromine adds across the C=C, so the orange colour disappears; an alkane would stay orange.

questions.q: Which petroleum fraction is used as a chemical feedstock?
questions.why: Naphtha is the feedstock; refinery gas is for heating and cooking, bitumen for roads, diesel for diesel engines.

questions.q: Which is the repeat unit of the addition polymer made from propene, CH₂=CHCH₃?
questions.why: The C=C becomes C–C in the main chain and the CH₃ group becomes a side group.
